status.description: done=fully finished; partial=some parts left; blocked=needs info/permission; failed=could not do it

summary.description: What was done and the outcome, at most ~120 words. Facts only. For a question or a summary task: the answer itself.

files_changed.description: Paths created/modified/deleted, relative to the workspace.

commands_run.description: Important commands only (tests, builds), not every ls.

verification.description: How the result was checked and what the check proves. 'not-run' if nothing was checked.

next_step.description: Single most useful next action for the orchestrator, or empty string.
